<DIV><P align=right style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:4pt'><B>EXHIBIT 23.1</B></P>
<P align=center style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:14pt'><B>Consent of Independent Registered Public Accounting Firm</B></P>
<P align=center style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt'><FONT style=font-size:10pt><I>November 4, 2026 &#8211;&nbsp;subject to review and signature by Fruci &amp; Associates II, PLLC</I></FONT></P>
<P align=center style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:14pt'><B>CONSENT OF INDEPENDENT REGISTERED PUBLIC ACCOUNTING FIRM</B></P>
<P style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:8pt'>We hereby consent to the inclusion in Amendment No. 1 to the Registration Statement on Form 10 (File No. 001-43172) of Biointra, Corp. of our report dated November 4, 2026, relating to the consolidated balance sheets of Biointra, Corp. (the &#8220;Company&#8221;) as of December 31, 2025 and 2024, and the related consolidated statements of operations and comprehensive loss, stockholders&#8217; deficit and cash flows for the year ended December 31, 2025 and for the period from May 8, 2024 (inception) to December 31, 2024, and the related notes. Our report includes an explanatory paragraph regarding substantial doubt about the Company&#8217;s ability to continue as a going concern.</P>
<P style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:12pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>/s/ Fruci &amp; Associates II, PLLC</P>
